hook.name: VolGuardHook
hook.description: A beforeSwap hook that dynamically adjusts LP fees based on trade size and an exponentially weighted moving average (EWMA) of recent trade volumes. Small trades pay 0.05%, with fees escalating to 0.3%, 1%, or 2% for larger or volatility-spiking trades. Optionally accepts pool TVL via hookData to use a ratio-based fee model instead of absolute thresholds.
